facts.text: The hotel is located between the Roma and Condesa neighborhoods of Mexico City.
facts.excerpt: Perfectly located between Roma and Condesa

facts.text: The hotel is set within a building by architect Jose Luis Benlliure.
facts.excerpt: Set within a masterpiece by renowned architect José Luis Benlliure

facts.text: Each room and suite features a signature Ara Starck mural.
facts.excerpt: is defined by a signature Ara Starck mural

facts.text: The Ara Starck mural in the rooms depicts aqueducts in bold primary and secondary colors, a nod to the history of Mexico City and the neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: the wall-length piece featuring aqueducts painted in bold primary and secondary colors is a genuflection at the history of Mexico City and this neighborhood

facts.text: The Roma Penthouse has 180-degree views of the Mexico City skyline from a private, fully furnished terrace.
facts.excerpt: Experience elevated living with sweeping 180º views of the Mexico City skyline from a private, fully furnished terrace.

facts.text: The Condesa Penthouse has 180-degree views of Condesa from a spacious private terrace.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy 180° views of Condesa from a spacious private terrace

facts.text: The Skyline Terrace Suite has a private furnished terrace with sweeping Mexico City skyline views.
facts.excerpt: a private furnished terrace and sweeping Mexico City skyline views

facts.text: The Mondrian Terrace Suite has sliding glass doors that open onto a large, fully furnished private terrace.
facts.excerpt: Sliding glass doors open to a large private terrace, fully furnished

facts.text: The Corner Suite has a living room, a bedroom and a soaking tub.

facts.text: Every room has a Marshall Bluetooth speaker.

facts.text: La Terraza by Mondrian is a patio offering bar snacks and classic cocktails.
